steps.title: Adjust Sample pH
steps.instruction: Acidify the sample to stop trypsin activity and optimize peptide binding to StageTips.

substeps.instruction: Add 10% TFA to a final concentration of 1% in the sample (typically around 20 µL).
Add 100 µL of 0.1% TFA.

steps.title: Prepare C18 StageTips
steps.instruction: Create C18 StageTips using Empore Disk C18 and pipette tips.

substeps.instruction: Cut three discs using a homemade plunger (each disc can hold 10 µg of protein, totaling 30 µg).
Insert the cut-out discs into a pipette tip.
Insert the tip into a 1.5 mL tube with a hole in the top (pierce twice as many tubes as samples needed; set half aside).

steps.title: Condition StageTips
steps.instruction: Prepare the StageTips by passing methanol and TFA through the discs.

substeps.instruction: Pass 50 µL of methanol through the StageTip and centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 2 min.
Pass 70 µL of 0.1% TFA through the StageTip and centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 4 min, ensuring all liquid passes through.
Swap Eppendorf tubes for clean tubes.

steps.title: Bind Peptides to StageTips
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto the StageTips to bind peptides.

substeps.instruction: Pass the sample through the StageTip (maximum 150 µL at a time).
Centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 5 min.
Repeat if necessary.
Keep tips in the fridge.

steps.title: Wash StageTips
steps.instruction: Wash the bound peptides on the StageTips.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 70 µL of 0.1% TFA.
Centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 5 min.
Repeat if necessary, ensuring no liquid remains on top of the discs.

steps.title: Store StageTips
steps.instruction: Store the prepared tips in designated boxes at -20 °C.

steps.title: Extract Peptides from Gel
steps.instruction: Recover peptides from the gel pieces.

substeps.instruction: Cover gel pieces with 100 µL of 100% ACN for 5-10 min.
Transfer the solution into a clean LoBind Eppendorf tube.
Dry the solution under vacuum centrifugation at 60 °C.

steps.title: Load Gel Extract onto StageTips
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried gel extract and apply it to the StageTips.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend with 100 µL of 0.1% TFA.
Pass the resuspension through the corresponding StageTips.
